governance_principle: Technical source qualification is determined only by data integrity: identity, timestamp semantics, point-in-time reproducibility, coverage, reliability, availability and reproducibility. Licensing, usage-rights and redistribution information is retained as metadata and never blocks technical qualification. Active research additionally preserves LevLine's zero-cost policy, and production use always requires explicit production authorization independent of source qualification.

family_rules.sportsbooks: May be aggregated only after each source is independently de-vigged and timestamped. Preserve per-book provenance and source count.
family_rules.prediction_exchanges: Never mix into sportsbook consensus by default. Evaluate as a separate information family with liquidity and microstructure controls.
family_rules.availability: Pregame player availability must be point-in-time reproducible, stable-ID mapped, and known by the tested forecast horizon. Actual snaps/participation are prohibited proxies.
family_rules.advanced_player_statistics: Observed player metrics require explicit source provenance, point-in-time validity and reproducibility before quantitative use. Rights metadata is non-blocking for technical qualification and remains separate display/governance metadata.
family_rules.historical_vs_prospective: Closing historical markets may benchmark information quality but cannot establish the best T-minus lock horizon. Lock-horizon selection requires prospective matched-horizon observations.
